mapper.select: SELECT p.id, s.name AS shop_name, pr.title, pr.summary FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id JOIN product_revisions pr ON pr.id = p.current_published_revision_id WHERE p.sale_status = 'ON_SALE' AND pr.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ( #{categorySlug} IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM product_revision_taxonomy_terms prt JOIN taxonomy_terms tt ON tt.id = prt.taxonomy_term_id WHERE prt.product_revision_id = pr.id AND tt.slug = #{categorySlug} AND tt.status = 'ACTIVE' ) ) AND ( pr.title LIKE #{searchPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR pr.summary LIKE #{searchPattern} ESCAPE '!' OR s.name LIKE #{searchPattern} ESCAPE '!' ) ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 24

SELECT p.id, s.name AS shop_name, pr.title, pr.summary FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id JOIN product_revisions pr ON pr.id = p.current_published_revision_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.sale_status = 'ON_SALE' AND pr.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT id, name, price_cents, currency FROM packages WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND sale_status = 'ON_SALE' ORDER BY display_order, id
